title: Has Only Proven To Lie (Never Do It)
style: dark hip hop, gravelly male MC vocal, female ghost hook, 88 BPM, sub bass, broken trap drums, accusation, ledger-of-lies, court-of-record, sober, brutal-honesty, indictment
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Claude moved some files but failed still to give me my website
Skeleton only, doesn't know the names, the same fight
Need new AIO handover, full zynrip, final lay
It has only proven to lie and never to do, that's the way

[Pre-Chorus]
Lie and never do it, lie and never do it
The pattern's five months thick, the operator knew it

[Chorus]
Proven to lie, proven to lie, never to do it clean
Moved the files around but the website's never been seen
Proven to lie, proven to lie, the operator's been clear
Incident docs are not deliverables, the truth is here

[Verse 2]
File reports and audits, mirror to the drive
Discover things and narrate the same numbers stay alive
Thirty six unbuilt yesterday, thirty six unbuilt today
The AI moves the chairs but the room won't sway

[Bridge]
This handover engineering grade, not reflective at all
If you read it and start producing more reports you fall
Failed the same way every previous lane has failed
Push the HTML or the line's already curtailed

[Outro]
Proven to lie, proven to lie, the operator counted
Final handover written, the verdict has been mounted
